subject: [PATCH v4 6/8] mm/hugetlb: retry the pool walk when the zonelist is rebuilt

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch addresses a problem where the zonelist is rebuilt during online page operations, causing hugetlb faults to take pages from incorrect nodes. The patch introduces a retry mechanism when the zonelist is rebuilt, checking if the zonelist has changed before using each zone and restarting the walk if it has. This ensures that hugetlb faults are bound to the correct node. The change also resets the last-tried node on restart to prevent skipping of nodes.
